questions.q: Choose the correct passive construction: “They are building a new hospital.”
opts: A new hospital is being built by them.
A new hospital is built by them.
A new hospital has been built by them.
A new hospital was being built by them.
questions.why: Present continuous passive: is/are being + past participle. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Identify the error: “She has went to the dispensary.”
questions.why: After 'has', use the past participle: 'has gone'. GPSC-style practice item.
